name: Whole Blood Measurements from the SpaceX Inspiration4 Mission
original_source: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) / TRISH / Weill Cornell Medicine
file_format: ISA-Tab, TSV/CSV count matrices, MultiQC HTML
accessibility: Processed tables open; raw human WGS/FASTQ controlled-access
license_info: NASA Open Science FAIR policy (human genomic access restrictions apply)
relevance_notes: Demonstrates pre-flight baseline vs. post-flight hematologic and transcriptomic shifts in civilian astronauts.
limitations: 3-day LEO mission; no continuous wearable vital-sign time series.

name: Inspiration4 Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMCs) Single-Cell Multiome
accessibility: Processed summary matrices open; raw sequencing controlled
relevance_notes: Documents spaceflight-associated immune cell chromatin and transcriptional remodeling.
limitations: Discrete blood draw timepoints rather than continuous onboard telemetry.

name: Inspiration4 Blood Plasma Proteomics, Metabolomics, and Cell-Free Nucleic Acids
relevance_notes: Captures systemic metabolic and cell-free stress biomarkers during orbital adaptation.
limitations: Short-duration LEO mission; biospecimen assay cadence only.

name: Inspiration4 Blood Serum Metabolic Panels and Immune/Cardiovascular Cytokines
relevance_notes: Provides empirical immune and cardiovascular biomarker context for closed-environment adaptation.
limitations: Not continuous real-time heart rate or SpO2 monitoring.

name: NASA OSDR Environmental Data Application (ISS Habitat Telemetry)
original_source: NASA Ames Life Sciences Data Archive (ALSDA) / OSDR
accessibility: Open public research access via OSDR EDA portal
relevance_notes: Defines real-world spacecraft environmental monitoring schemas for CO2, thermal, humidity, and radiation tracking.
limitations: Payload/habitat telemetry rather than personal wearable astronaut physiology.

name: NASA Life Sciences Data Archive / NASA Life Sciences Portal
original_source: NASA Johnson Space Center & Ames Research Center
variables: De-identified cardiovascular, musculoskeletal, sleep, and behavioral experiment records
record_count: Historical Shuttle, ISS, and analog mission archives
accessibility: Catalog public; human physiological datasets require formal NASA Data Request & IRB governance
license_info: NASA Human Research Privacy & Data Use Agreement
relevance_notes: Primary NASA archive for longitudinal human spaceflight physiology and sleep/behavioral studies.
limitations: Restricted access for individual human physiological records; not bundled unauthenticated.

name: NASA Human Research Roadmap & HRP Evidence Reports
variables: Integrated Research Plan (IRP) risks and gaps
relevance_notes: Authoritative scientific grounding for the five hazards, physiological mechanisms, and medical autonomy requirements.
limitations: Narrative evidence reports and risk matrices rather than raw patient-level telemetry.

name: Aegis 30-Day Synthetic Crew & Habitat Telemetry Benchmark
record_count: 90 daily crew health records + 90 habitat environmental records (30 days x 3 synthetic profiles)
accessibility: Bundled locally for offline development, ML benchmarking, and demonstration
license_info: Apache-2.0 (Synthetic Benchmark Only — Not Real Astronaut Data)
relevance_notes: Enables offline personal-baseline ML training, multivariable Isolation Forest evaluation, and anomaly explanation testing.
limitations: Programmatically generated synthetic values with labeled injected perturbations; must never be interpreted as real clinical or NASA flight data.

name: Operator Manual & Voice-Confirmed Mission Logs
original_source: Local Crew / Flight Surgeon Workstation Input
relevance_notes: Captures operator-verified inputs and voice-extracted structured observations with explicit confirmation.
limitations: Depends on operator adherence and microphone transcription verification.
